review: position-loose-material@1 adds one general operation, position-loose-material (learning 1, one study round at 0.2 energy), registered last for this run's scope, that lays one carried loose unit on clear ground within reach at a chosen point and angle (radians) as an ordinary ground item. Modes: inspect (one round, 0.2 energy; target, optional x, y and angle) reports the unit and site facts with every unknown and unmet requirement and leaves a closed record, inspected or infeasible; place (target, x, y, angle, quantity 1) is stage 1, the same paid inspection (0.2), which reserves the exact unit in carried inventory (the item itself when it is one unit, otherwise one whole unit split exactly from it with every field kept, as collective-work reserves, mapped one to one) and keeps the requested transform, findings and remaining stage in an open work record shown as active work, then continues in the next round of the same action with stage 2 (0.5 energy): 2 rounds and 0.7 energy in all; inspect-progress (one round, 0.2) reports the open or latest record, the live checks for open work, and for a completed placement only what is in view; resume continues the unpaid stage 2 after fresh checks; cancel (one round, no energy) releases the reservation once and leaves the unit carried; paid effort is never refunded and every refusal comes before any cost. Reuse: stage 2 calls the ordinary drop of foundation-forest@1 (FOREST_BASE.handlers forest.drop) with the exact unit, so ownership, quantity, conservation, transfer validation, its 0.5 energy and the carried-to-ground id mapping of its dropped event are drop's own and its contract is unchanged; the operation then sets that ground item at the destination, records the transform on it (processing.groundPlacement) and adds a footprint record, an object of kind placed-loose-material (not solid, reserved, a rectangle of the rod length by its diameter at the angle), which nearby people observe with position, angle, footprint, material, origin, harvest round and placer, next to the ground item in their ordinary ground view; recovery is base pickup at its own cost, and after each round the footprint record ends (material-placement-removed) when the item is taken, divided or moved, and any stale placement record is cleared from items. Modeling assumptions: the only authoritative shape is the declared rod of small-combustion-source@1 (smallFireRod: 900 kg/m3, length 25 diameters, from the represented unit mass, so a branch unit is 0.991 x 0.0396 m), applied as prepare-ventilated-food-storage@1 does to branch, willow, birch and oak, but only to rigid wood (flexibility at most 3); willow therefore bends, and stone, food, every other material and worked, combined, equipment or partial units report their shape as unknown and cannot be placed, that mechanism being left for later development; the rod is straight, its curvature and surface are not represented; handling means the person already carries the unit and its rod fits the two-handed grip range of that package (1.5-5 cm), with no other strength or load limit; manual reach is the body radius plus the interaction range (0.87 m) to the centre, the reach pickup needs; supportable ground means every sample point (ends, quarter points, centre) is visible from the person and firm by the ex19 rule (not water, shallow water, a wet bank or waterlogging above 0.1); clear means the whole footprint lies inside the world and overlaps no living person (the placer included), no object of any kind (plants, signs, reserved surfaces and earlier placed units included) and no loose ground item; another action, lost reach or sight, an obstruction or energy below 0.5 pauses before stage 2 without charge, while a changed unit (any field except age, position, ownership and reservation), shape or ground ends the work as infeasible and frees the unit, so placing again makes a new paid inspection; death ends open work and releases the unit once to the death rules; drop's semantics stay, so the ground item gets a new id from drop (mapped) and pickup gives the taken item another new id, both keeping material, origin and harvest round; the footprint record's interaction range is the interaction range less the rod's half diagonal, so reaching it keeps the item within pickup reach; placed units persist under the existing rules and nothing arranges, maintains or improves them; two simultaneous placements with overlapping footprints are both rejected by the kernel's object conflict check. No reward: no satisfaction rule; the completion event never carries a qualified flag, so the install's practice rule cannot fire; events carry no top-level progress, elapsed or remaining numbers, so they earn no routine progress credit; a check in expression-incentives gated on this revision keeps placed units out of made work, so they never bring a work-noticed award even with incentives on (they are off here), and the other worlds replay unchanged. Visuals: a new placed-rod viewer drawing shows a placed unit as its rod at the recorded length, thickness and angle in its material colour (rotating itself, because the forest canvas draws package visuals unrotated, as rain-canopy does) and any other state as a dashed outline only; events carry loose-material view metadata (component, material, colour, transform, footprint, condition, status and reason) that stays provisional until completion, no object exists before it, and nothing marks an arrangement, quality or success; every existing drawing is unchanged.
